steps.name: ui-primitives
steps.summary: Added SectionCard, StatusIconCircle, UsageBadge, UploadDropzone, FileRowCard, GoogleButton (src/components/ui/<Name>/) with tests, exported from src/components/ui/index.ts, and demoed in src/app/style-guide/page.tsx.

steps.name: landing-page
steps.summary: Replaced src/app/page.tsx with the Server Component landing page (header, hero, 3-col feature cards, pricing/format strip, ADR-015 overseas-transfer notice + /privacy link) and added src/app/privacy/page.tsx as a minimal placeholder policy page; both responsive at the 640px breakpoint.

steps.name: auth-screens
steps.summary: Added src/app/login/page.tsx (Client Component: GoogleButton + loading overlay with Spinner, inline demo sign-in failure state, back link) and src/app/welcome/page.tsx (Server Component: StatusIconCircle success + CTA to /dashboard), both 400-440px centered.

steps.name: dashboard-screen
steps.summary: Added src/app/dashboard/page.tsx (Client Component with local-state DashboardView machine: empty/file-selected/upload-error/extract-error/analyzing/analysis-error/result), using a real file input for CSV/PDF + 20MB validation, setTimeout-simulated synchronous analysis (ADR-017) that decrements freeRemaining (floor 0) and clears on unmount/retry, and a 740px 3-SectionCard result view (category bars, anomalies with Alert badges, recommendations, reference-info disclaimer) with mock data matching the spec exactly.
